question: Can pretrained world models or visual representations be adapted with QLC, PSC or TEC modules instead of retraining the entire model?
type: Focused bounded scoping supplement; not an exhaustive systematic review
scope: pretrained frozen representation plus learned dynamics
inclusion: Primary papers and official author repositories/model cards with accessible claims relevant to adaptation, constraints or evaluation. Preprints allowed and labeled.
exclusion: Marketing claims, secondary summaries as claim evidence, unrelated quantum hardware speedup, closed models with no usable latent access as implementation hosts.
search_sources: Web discovery targeting arXiv, OpenReview, proceedings and author repositories
backend_limitation: parallel-cli not on PATH and PARALLEL_API_KEY not configured; built-in web retrieval used. No authenticated Parallel pipeline or exhaustive database export claimed.
reviewers: One assistant; no independent human screening
decision: Compare side-module and core-replacement routes; do not presuppose pretrained PSC superiority or direct transfer from manipulation to dynamic navigation.
execution: Literature and design only; no model downloads, API spend, cluster submission or training authorized by this supplement.
